The '''Grand Army of the Republic broadcast''' was a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] broadcast dedicated to the servicemen of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The broadcast was transmitted across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], reaching [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and other members of the Grand Army of the Republic in various locations, like [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]] and the [[Rishi moon]]. A [[Bettie-Bot VJ|Bettie-Bot]] worked as a VJ for a music show on the broadcasting system.
